items: 【Built-in Power Outlets】No more crawling under your desk for outlets! Stay powered up with 4 AC outlets, 1 USB port, and 1 USB-C ports on the L shaped gaming desk, supporting multiple devices at once. This work desk is perfect for charging laptops, phones, and office gadgets without cluttering your workspace

【Thicker Desktop & Heavy Workloads】From paperwork to creative projects, this 0.95 inches thick, high-density desktop l shaped office desk gives you the sturdy, scratch-resistant, waterproof surface and 220 lbs weight capacity you need to focus and get things done. Plenty of space for multiple monitors, notebooks, and that much-needed coffee

【Reversible L Shaped Computer Desk】Need more space? This reversible l desk can be tucked neatly into a corner or reversed to fit your setup with large legroom. Got a work buddy? Combine 2 pc desks for a seamless 2-person workstation. Plus, the L-shape gives your elbows proper support and extra room for monitors, notebooks, and, of course, coffee

【Stable, Sturdy & Office-Ready】Wobbly gaming desks? Not here. With a reinforced steel frame, thickened legs, and crossbars for extra support, this work from home desk stays solid, perfect for home office, gaming room, study and anywhere you need a stable desk. Plus: Adjustable feet keep it stable on any uneven floors

【Easy Setup, Easy Moves】Nobody likes a complicated assembly process. We've made setting up this studio desk a breeze with clear instructions, numbered parts, and all the necessary tools included. This desk for bedroom is compactly packaged, enabling you to move it with ease — whether you're upgrading your home office or creating a sleek new workspace
